question: The human being CAN NOT:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Fatty acids" -> "acetyl-CoA" -> "no net conversion to glucose" -> 90%
analysis: In human metabolism, glucose can be converted to lactate through anaerobic glycolysis. Carbohydrates can be transformed into fatty acids via acetyl-CoA. Pyruvate can be converted back into glucose through gluconeogenesis. However, humans lack the enzymatic pathways to convert fatty acids into carbohydrates, as the conversion of acetyl-CoA (derived from fatty acids) into glucose is not possible due to the irreversible nature of the pyruvate dehydrogenase reaction.
